notes: The San Francisco City Planning Commission's minutes of its regular and special meetings, June to November 1978, from volume 37 of the San Francisco Public Library's deposit at the Internet Archive (37minutesofsanfran1978san). Pages were split from the hOCR search text on the Internet Archive page index, counting the viewer page among the leaves scandata.xml does not mark addToAccessFormats=false, and every page is dated from the meeting header it sits under. Four kinds of finding: what the Commission decided about a property, dated to the meeting that decided it; what the minutes state stood on or occupied the property; dated past facts the minutes state about a building; and landmark actions. A proposal on its own is not a finding. A Board of Supervisors or Board of Permit Appeals action the minutes report without its own date is framed 'by' the date of the meeting that reported it. The minutes name applicants, owners, attorneys, objectors, commissioners and staff throughout; the reader spec (in research/sources/sf-planning-commission-minutes.md, under Reader spec) barred all of them from every field, and kept companies, institutions, named buildings and architects.

coverage.remaining: Every page of volume 37 (37minutesofsanfran1978san, labelled June-Nov 1978) was read. Despite the label it holds only 17 meetings: the four special evening hearings on the residential rezoning of 7, 13, 20 and 27 June, and the regular meetings of 20 July, 3 and 24 August, 7 and 14 September, 5 October and 9 and 16 November, with the special EIR hearings of 14 and 21 November. No regular meeting of June, nor those of 6, 13 and 27 July, 31 August, 21 and 28 September, 12, 19 and 26 October, 2 and 30 November, is in the scan, though the minutes continue cases to several of them. Next: volume 38 (1979), then 39 (1980) and 40-58 (1994-2005).
coverage.note: 124 OCR pages of minutes text out of 246 viewer pages (248 scanned leaves; most odd viewer pages are blank versos, n160-n175 consecutive), read in one session by a single reader with no sub-agents; 17 meetings, each dated from its own header. The June hearings (n4-n96, 47 text pages) are the last neighbourhood hearings and the adoption of the citywide residential zoning (Resolutions 7995-7997, 27 June) and locate almost nothing. 39 findings: 26 planning decision, 11 occupancy, 2 site history.
